# Title
Implement batch data update

## Description
As an admin, I want to trigger a batch job that updates data from external sources so that the application remains current.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Endpoint `/api/update-data` triggers the batch update.
- Scheduler runs daily to refresh data.
- Update avoids duplicates.

## Definition of Done
- Endpoint logs updates and returns HTTP 200.
- Scheduler runs automatically once a day.
- Tests confirm job execution.

## Subtasks
- Create batch service with Spring @Scheduled.
- Implement REST endpoint to trigger updates manually.
- Write test mocking data updates.
